mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before requesting a quote for a secondary dwelling unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before reaching out to a contractor, gather key information about your goals and physical property. Decide on the primary intended occupant, such as an aging parent, visiting guests, or independent tenants, as this dictates needs like step-free walk-in showers or private kitchen appliances. Locate your property survey or boundary markers to clarify available yard space, and note the location of your main electrical panel and sewer or septic cleanouts. Having these details ready allows Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms to assess feasibility quickly during your free quote consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Determine the unit's intended purpose, outline accessibility and layout needs, and locate your property survey along with primary plumbing and electrical service points.
